hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: List of hosts or URLs to check. Protocols and paths are removed. Append :port for a non-standard port, e.g. api.example.com:8443. IP addresses are matched against IP SANs. TLS only (port 443 by default); STARTTLS is not supported.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache minutes
cacheMinutes.description: How many minutes a charged host verdict stays cached in the buyer's store. Cache hits are delivered and are NOT charged. 0 disables the cache.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many TLS checks run in parallel.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Connect and handshake timeout per host.

timeBudgetSeconds.title: Time budget seconds
timeBudgetSeconds.description: Optional: stop the run after this many seconds. Hosts that were not read are listed in the SUMMARY row.
